fields.meta_description: Build a check request form that requires the receipt, sends each request to its approvers, and records the check number once paid. Free to start.
fields.h1: Build a Check Request Form That Gets Signed and Paid
fields.hero_description: Build a check request form that requires receipts, routes each request for approval, and logs every check you write.
fields.features_heading: What a Check Request Form Should Handle
fields.features_subheading: A PDF collects a payee and a signature. These parts carry the request from the receipt to a written check.
fields.feature_1:
Receipts required before submit

Make the receipt or invoice a required upload. A request without one cannot be sent, and the treasurer no longer chases paperwork weeks after a check has already gone out.
fields.feature_2:
Approvers in the order you set

Name who signs and in what order, such as a committee chair first and the president next. Each approver gets an email with the receipt, and the next one hears only after a yes.
fields.feature_3:
A duplicate check on invoice numbers

Each new request is compared with the invoice numbers already paid. A match holds the request and shows the check that already paid it, before two people pay the same bill twice.
fields.feature_4:
Account codes from a list

Requesters pick the budget line from a drop-down list. One purchase can be split across two accounts, and the form will not submit until the split adds up to the request total.
fields.feature_5:
Check numbers written back

The treasurer records the check number and the date it was mailed. The request closes, the requester gets an email, and anyone can search by payee to see what was paid and when.
fields.feature_6:
Source code to keep

Export the full source code of your check request app to your GitHub repository on paid plans. A developer can host it on your own servers or connect it to your accounting system.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Pays Through a Check Request Form
fields.tab_content_1:
With the receipt attached, two officers sign

Maria Lopez bought $86.40 of signs and tape for the fall book fair at Oakridge Elementary. She fills in the PTA check request on her phone and photographs the receipt, which the form requires before it will send. The president and the treasurer both approve, and the treasurer writes check 1047 to Maria.
fields.tab_content_2:
One invoice number in two requests

Catering invoices reach the history department at Hollis University twice, by email to the admin and on paper to the chair. The admin files a check request for invoice 2207 from Fenwick Catering, $1,250.00. The form finds that invoice already paid with check 5531 and holds the request for the business office.
fields.tab_content_3:
The $250 deposit back with its receipt number

Renters at Elm Street Community Center pay a $250 deposit when they book the main hall. After a Saturday birthday party, the facilities supervisor walks the room and marks it clean. That opens a check request to the renter for $250 with the original receipt number, R-3318, and it waits with finance for approval.
fields.tab_content_4:
Every check this week, by due date

Every Monday the treasurer of the Riverside Youth Soccer League opens the week's approved check requests. Each carries a due date, and the list is sorted by it. Referee fees of $640.00 are due Friday and sit at the top, ahead of field rental. Four checks go out this week. Together they come to $1,915.00.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Check Request Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a check request form that gets every payment approved and on record, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write down who approves a check request and in what order, and whether a larger amount adds a signer. PTA guidance asks for two signatures on every check. A university office may add a dean above a set amount. Nobody approves a payment to themselves.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask for the payee's name and mailing address, the amount, the purpose, and when the payee has to be paid. Add the requester's name and contact details. Leave out bank account and tax ID numbers, which belong in a separate, protected vendor record.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Require an itemized receipt with every request, or the vendor's invoice for a bill. For an advance, where no receipt exists yet, ask for a quote instead and a receipt within a set number of days after the purchase. Show the requester which one applies.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Put your budget lines or account codes in a drop-down so nobody types a code from memory. Allow a split across two or more accounts when one purchase serves several programs, and check that the split amounts add up to the request total.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste your fields, approvers, receipt rule, and account list into the prompt. Emergent builds the form, the approval steps, and the database behind them. Say who hears about a held request, and change any part later by prompting again.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Close the loop with the check number
fields.howto_step_6_des: Give the treasurer one screen for the check number and the day it went out, by mail or by hand. That closes the request and emails the requester. Keep paid requests searchable by payee and invoice number for your next audit.
fields.howto_step_7_des: File a request as a volunteer with a photographed receipt, then file the same invoice a second time. Confirm the second one is held. Approve the first as each signer, record a check number, and open the saved record to see every step.

plan.angle: The top 10 is paper: PTA and school district PDFs, university business-office forms, a town's reimbursement PDF, a Jotform template and a TemplateLab gallery. Each one collects a payee, an amount and a signature, then leaves the treasurer to chase the receipt, check the account code, spot a bill already paid and tell the requester when the check went out. This page treats the check request form as the front of the payment process: receipts required before submit, approvers in order, a duplicate check on the invoice number, and the check number written back to the request. It covers four settings that pay differently (a PTA volunteer reimbursement, a university vendor invoice, a community center deposit refund, a youth league's weekly check run) and leaves expense reports, budget requests and wire transfers to their own pages.
